# Kolibri tokenizer data

The image build downloads `tokenizer.json` from Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1,
revision `35bc4d3be745502227a67247de77d70e691614ee`. The data is distributed under
the Apache License 2.0, included unchanged in [Kolibri-1-LICENSE.txt](Kolibri-1-LICENSE.txt).

Source: https://huggingface.co/Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1/tree/35bc4d3be745502227a67247de77d70e691614ee

Only tokenizer data is included, not model weights or executable model code.
`llm_assets.py` verifies the pinned file's SHA-256 during the build.
